_howto: Systems shown on /rack/ in addition to the PVE host + this VM. Fields: id, name, role (subtitle), check: 'ping'|'http'|null, target (IP or URL), vmid (optional — merges CPU/MEM/uptime from the PVE push when the tds cron is installed). Edit this file on the VM at /opt/status-writer/rack.json — picked up on the next 30s writer run, no restarts needed.
